name: Organisation 39
definition: Organised structure that is set up for a particular purpose, for example, a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which the organisation is known and which is usually used to identify that organisation.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Name of the organisation in short form.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the organisation.

LegalEntityIdentifier.name: Legal Entity Identifier
LegalEntityIdentifier.definition: Identification of the organisation with a Legal Entity Identifier. This is a code allocated to a party as described in ISO 17442 "Financial Services - Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)".

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Purpose of the organisation, for example, charity.

RegistrationCountry.name: Registration Country
RegistrationCountry.definition: Country in which the organisation is registered.

RegistrationDate.name: Registration Date
RegistrationDate.definition: Date and time at which a given organisation was officially registered.

PostalAddress.name: Postal Address
PostalAddress.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

PlaceOfListing.name: Place Of Listing
PlaceOfListing.definition: Place of listing for shares in the organisation.

OrganisationElementRule.definition: One of the elements (Name, ShortName, Identification, LegalEntityIdentifier, Purpose, RegistrationCountry, RegistrationDate, PostalAddress, TypeOfOrganisation, PlaceOfListing) must be present.
